items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023

ctx.x: I was not in charge of what they did as characters on stage. I was only asked to write music arrangements and I tried to make sure that the band played the music, you know played those correctly, you know in the right style and the right feel. And it wasn’t up to me whether they were funny or not.
Yeah. It wasn’t Spike Jones funny. It was, if it was going to be funny it was going to be those two guys.

Exactly. They — yeah. We just backed up these guys, and that was — my whole career at Saturday Night Live for ten years I was arranger for ten — I was also the music director from ’81 to ’85. You know Eddie Murphy, Joe Piscopo, Martin Short, Billy Crystal era. I wrote the music to “Hot Tub.” I didn’t write the lyrics but I wrote “Hot Tub” and I produced the pre-record for that scene.
